# Support and Operational Observations

## Recent Patterns

- Advisors sometimes receive an empty queue until a search cache is rebuilt.
- Appointment reminders occasionally run twice after a server restart.
- Large attachments can leave a case visible without a usable file.
- Category changes can cause historical reports to use the new label.
- Users report that reopening a case sometimes changes its priority.

## Recovery Practices

Support staff restart failed scheduled jobs from an administration screen.
They keep a private checklist because the runbook covers only two of the six
jobs currently visible.

Database backups are tested quarterly. Attachment-share recovery was last
tested at an unknown date.

## Operational Calendar

Case volumes are highest on weekday mornings and during the first week of each
month. The weekly reporting pack must be available before the Monday
operations review.

## Undocumented Use

One department uses a category intended for general enquiries to track
internal review work. Removing that category would affect its local process.
